component.name: FreeFEM
component.summary: Solve partial differential equations with finite elements

description.p: FreeFEM is a scripting language and finite element solver for two- and three-dimensional partial differential equations. It provides mesh generation, numerical solvers and interactive plots for multiphysics simulations.
This community package runs the official upstream Linux build unmodified. Separate HDF5, compression and OpenGL utility libraries support the solver and its plotting window.

The app menu runs the upstream Laplace tutorial in a terminal with an interactive plot; its Laplace.eps output is saved in the app data directory. Run your own scripts with flatpak run io.github.FreeFem.FreeFEM /path/to/model.edp. Add -nw for calculations without a plot window. For local parallel runs, use flatpak run --command=freefem-mpi io.github.FreeFem.FreeFEM -n 4 /path/to/model.edp. For PETSc-complex scripts, add --env=FREEFEM_PETSC_VARIANT=complex before the app ID to select the bundled complex solver libraries.

Scripts can read and write Documents by default. For projects elsewhere, grant their directory with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/projects io.github.FreeFem.FreeFEM. Undo custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.FreeFem.FreeFEM.

Host compilers, external editors and cluster services are not available inside the sandbox. Building new plugins requires a separate development environment. Network access for scripts is optional: flatpak override --user --share=network io.github.FreeFem.FreeFEM.
